ios.desc:
KyPass is designed for users who demand the highest level of security for their personal data.

It is fully compatible with the open-source KeePass Password Safe database format, allowing you to manage your credentials securely and efficiently across all your devices.

Secure Sync and Backup

Your encrypted database can be stored and synchronized using:
• iCloud Drive
• Dropbox
• Google Drive
• OneDrive (personal and business)
• SFTP
• Any WebDAV-compatible cloud service

Powerful and Complete

KyPass stores all your sensitive information — usernames, passwords, URLs, notes, and more — in a single, encrypted database.
Entries are organized into groups, and the built-in search lets you find what you need instantly.

Exclusive Features

• Tree view navigation (ideal on iPad)
• Full field reference support
• Complete history management (view and maintain previous versions)
• Recycle Bin support
• Folder selection for Dropbox and WebDAV
• Attachment support (read and write)

And Also

• Multi-cloud synchronization across all your devices
• Safari and third-party browser integration
• Advanced password generator with smart character rules
• KDBX4 support
• External keyboard compatibility
• Local WebDAV browser for direct imports
• Download database directly from a URL
• Touch ID or PIN protection (securely stores the master key in iOS Keychain)
• One-Time Password (OTP) support
• Barcode sharing for entries
• Detailed entry information including creation, modification, and expiry dates

KyPass is powerful enough to replace your desktop password manager, yet simple enough to use anywhere.
Discover the most complete and secure KeePass-compatible app for iPhone and iPad.
